description.zh: text-to-cad 的 gcode / bambu-labs 技能用到的外部应用（OrcaSlicer 切片、Bambu Studio、Bambu Connect 发打印；cam 技能铣削用的 FreeCAD）：首次使用时自动下载安装，之后运行其命令行或用它打开文件。经用户确认后执行。
description.en: External apps used by the text-to-cad gcode / bambu-labs skills (OrcaSlicer slicing, Bambu Studio, Bambu Connect printing; FreeCAD for cam milling): installed automatically on first use, then run their command line or open files in them. Runs after user confirmation.

action.description: ensure：找到应用，未安装则自动下载安装（Bambu Connect 打开官方下载页）；run：运行它的命令行（如 OrcaSlicer 无头切片）；open：用它打开工作目录里的文件，或打开 bambu-connect:// 链接

args.description: run：命令行参数（--outputdir 用绝对路径）

target.description: open：工作目录内的文件路径，或 bambu-connect://import-file?… 链接

action.description: ensure: locate the app, installing it automatically if missing (Bambu Connect opens its official download page); run: run its command line (e.g. headless OrcaSlicer slicing); open: open a workspace file in it, or a bambu-connect:// link

args.description: run: command-line arguments (give --outputdir an absolute path)

target.description: open: a workspace file path, or a bambu-connect://import-file?… link
